title: String pattern guard
responsibility: Checks a string against a regular expression without retaining its match position.

inputs.name: matchesPattern.value
inputs.description: The candidate value to check. Only string values are tested; any other type returns false without reading the pattern.

inputs.name: matchesPattern.pattern
inputs.description: The regular expression that value is tested against; it is used only when value is a string. For string values, lastIndex is set to 0 before and after the test, which overwrites any stored position, so a global or sticky pattern keeps no position between calls.

outputs.name: matchesPattern
outputs.description: Returns true only when value is a string and pattern.test finds a match in it, which narrows value to string where the result is true. It returns false for non-string values and for strings with no match, so a false result does not show that value is not a string.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when value is a string and pattern is null, undefined, or a value that cannot take a lastIndex or lacks a test method, because the function assigns pattern.lastIndex and calls pattern.test without a check. Non-string values return false before pattern is read, so they never throw this.
